title: button variant roles
rule: Text = less-pronounced (typical in dialogs and cards; on cards, text buttons keep emphasis on card content). Contained = high-emphasis (elevation + fill); primary to the app. Outlined = medium-emphasis: important but not the primary; lower than contained, higher than text.
pass_when: Variant matches that role map (text / outlined / contained).
fail_when: Contained used for a low-emphasis card action, or text used as the app's primary.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
do_not_claim: One-primary page cap as this variant-map row; M3 max-two-actions (not on this MUI page).
